response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT c.constructorId, c.nationality, COUNT(cs.constructorStandingsId) AS record_count FROM constructors c LEFT JOIN constructorStandings cs ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.nationality) SELECT constructorId, nationality, record_count, record_count - (SELECT AVG(record_count * 1.0) FROM counts) AS diff_from_avg FROM counts ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The average is taken over all constructors in the constructors table (including those with 0 records), and the difference is record_count minus that average, unrounded.
Ties at the 10th place are cut arbitrarily by LIMIT 10.
